input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Arizona, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof.
input.rationale: Arizona law is outside our accepted list (New York preferred; Delaware, California or England and Wales as fallback), so this fails the fallback. Disputes are also pushed into mandatory USA&M arbitration with no stated seat, whereas we require courts. Redline moves governing law and exclusive venue to New York County and, if arbitration is retained, seats it there.

input.quote: Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: The consent requirement is mutual and reasonableness-qualified, but there is no carve-out allowing us to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger or asset sale, which the fallback requires; on its face our internal reorganisations and M&A transactions need Contractor's consent. Redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out on written notice and confirms a change of control gives Contractor no termination or re-pricing right.

input.quote: all drawings, documents, designs, models, inventions, computer programs, computer systems, data, computer documentation and other tangible materials authored or prepared by Contractor for Company as the work product required by a Statement of Work (collectively, the "Works"), are the property of Company
input.rationale: The Works vest in Company, Contractor keeps only its pre-existing tools and know-how, and Section 4(c) grants a perpetual, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to any Contractor Information embedded in the Works; Section 4(d) confirms our right to modify and engage others. Nothing assigns our IP or data to Contractor and there is no joint ownership. We note ownership is conditioned on payment of the relevant invoice and there is no express Customer Data ownership sentence — points to raise, not deviations.

input.quote: Contractor hereby grants to Company a royalty-free, non- exclusive perpetual license (including the right to grant a sublicense) to use, copy, modify, create, derivative version, publicly perform and publicly display such Contractor's Information in connection with Company's business operations.
input.rationale: The grant runs to Company alone: affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf are excluded with no mechanism to add them, the licence is not stated to be irrevocable, and it is not transferable to a successor (Section 10 restricts assignment). That fails the fallback (affiliates on notice; transferable in an M&A transaction). Redline makes minimal additions to the existing grant without disturbing Contractor's ownership of its background IP.

input.quote: Contractor shall bill Company as set forth in the relevant Statement of Work. Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced
input.rationale: There is no audit, inspection or verification right running against Company anywhere in the document; the records obligations run in our favour (Contractor must supply invoice detail and receipts), and Section 1(c) gives Contractor no access rights beyond compliance with our own security policies.

input.quote: Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalties, early-termination fee or minimum charge is payable by Company — termination only triggers payment for Services actually performed, and Section 5(d) even relieves us of fees where Contractor breaches the anti-bribery covenant. Nothing to redline.

input.quote: THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
input.rationale: Section 5 gives only legal-compliance (knowledge-qualified), authority and non-infringement representations — there is no warranty that the Works conform to the Specifications, no warranty period and no remedy, and the implied warranties are disclaimed, so there is no usable conformance warranty at any level. The professional and workmanlike standard in Section 1(b) is a performance covenant without a remedy. Redline inserts the fallback 90-day conformance warranty with re-performance/repair/replacement/refund and a no-malicious-code warranty.

input.quote: Contractor shall maintain workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute, comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) and professional errors and omissions insurance for bodily injury, property damage or other losses with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000)
input.rationale: Workers' comp, CGL USD 1M and E&O USD 1M are in place with certificates on request, but there is no cyber/privacy cover even though Contractor obtains our records, data and access to our computer systems (Sections 1(c) and 8) — the fallback requires E&O USD 1M plus cyber USD 2M. Redline adds a single cyber line at the fallback level; the lower E&O and missing CGL aggregate limits are points we would raise but not press.

input.quote: Contractor will be compensated on a time and materials.
input.rationale: Compensation is time-and-materials under each Statement of Work on a task-by-task basis, with no minimum hours, retainer, take-or-pay commitment, shortfall charge or volume cap binding Company.

input.quote: Upon receipt of final payment Contractor shall provide to Company, and will assigns to Company, all right, title and interest to any Works in progress.
input.rationale: Termination only addresses final payment and assignment of works in progress; there is no transition assistance, no obligation to return our data or Confidential Information in a usable format, no timeline and no deletion certification (Section 8 imposes no return obligation either). Redline inserts the standard exit paragraph: up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in machine-readable format, then certified deletion.
